prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1394; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Pearland, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had been waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic and was moving slowly when the impact happened. Immediately afterward my neck snapped forward and back, and by the next morning I was dealing with stiffness, headaches, and pain running into my shoulders. I have described the collision the same way every time I have spoken about it, to the officer at the scene, to the adjuster, and to the medical staff who examined me. I am the driver of the vehicle, and I live in the same household as the policyholder, so I am submitting this statement as a covered member of that household.
